title: Iinkulungwane Ezilithoba Zobizo
intro: Khawuzibone umi wedwa ujongene nomsinga wokugculelwa ixesha elide kuneekumkani eziphakamayo neziwayo, zibiza ubusuku nemini ngelixa iindlebe zigqunyiwe kwaye neengubo zitsalwa ngokuqinileyo. Ngaphambili kukho inqanawa eyakhiwe emhlabeni owomileyo nasemanzini engafaniyo naleyo yakha yabonwa ngaphambili. Ngaba uyayibona inzondelelo engaphaya kolu gqatso lokumenywa?
clues: Ndibamemile abantu bam ubusuku nemini, ngasese nangokucacileyo, ukuba banqule uAllah kuphela.
Abantu bam bafaka iminwe ezindlebeni zabo, bazigquma ngeengubo ukuze baphambuke kum.
Ndahlala phakathi kwabantu bam kangangeminyaka engamakhulu alithoba anamashumi amahlanu ndibabiza ukuba bafikelele kwisikhokelo.
Ndakha isitya phantsi kwamehlo ka-Allah nesityhilelo ngelixa abantu bam bendigculela emhlabeni owomileyo.
Ndayalelwa ukuba ndithwale izibini zazo zonke iintlobo kunye namakholwa xa umyalelo ufika kwaye i-oven iphuphuma.
Ndibukele amaza enyuka njengeentaba njengoko umkhukula wawugubungela abo bangavumanga, ngelixa uAllah ebasindisa abo babesemkhombeni.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
verse: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day. (71:5)
